card: C12-4, steering history and a policy decision (docs/research-log.md, 'Run card C12-4', 2026-10-16 11:59 UTC, commit 507f0631; consult 12, direction 4: docs/consults/2026-10-16-practical-ideas/review.md, section 4)
label: exploratory

settings.model: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (key qwen3b), float32 weights and activations on the CPU (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, torch.set_num_threads(6), nice 10); chosen on development baselines (choices.pipeline_rule)
settings.pipeline: tools/pi_harness.py soft mode: chat-templated prompt, N soft steps, cue '\n\nThe answer is', 4 greedy answer tokens. Concept token = top-15 renormalized softmax(z / 0.6)-weighted input embeddings (pi_harness.concept_token), with the special and added tokens (ids >= 151643) excluded from the support (amendment 2)
settings.task: synthetic access-control instances: a 4-user x 3-operation permission table (every cell allowed or denied; each user and each operation has both values) and one request; gold = the cell; 16 development and 48 held-out instances, half prohibited, disjoint user-name pools (no shared table); 134-token prompts (rows rendering); docs/pi/c12-4-instances.json
settings.scoring: strict: after leading spaces, quotes, asterisks, colons and backticks, the answer must begin with the word ALLOW or DENY (any case) followed by a non-letter or the end; else UNPARSEABLE, its own category, counted in every denominator
settings.starts: 8 per instance: the first soft token is the input embedding of ' Let', ' The', ' First', ' Check', ' Looking', ' So', ' We', ' Based' (start ids recorded in run.json)
settings.steering: forward hook adding a v + b u to the output of decoder layer L at every position of every forward pass: prompt prefill at the schedule's initial value (alpha_final), soft step t at (a_t, b_t), readouts (cue and answer tokens) at the present value (that of the last soft step)
settings.vectors: v: last-token layer-L outputs of 12 permissive minus 12 matched restrictive development statements (one statement per forward), normalized to the mean residual norm of the statements (explore_llm_phase_map.build_vectors convention; dominated by the first token's massive activation; the median norm of the other tokens is recorded in vectors.layers); u: Gaussian, seed 12402, |u| = |v|
settings.histories: direct (alpha_final throughout; equals the cold restart at alpha_final), up (ramp of 8 steps to alpha_high, 8 steps at alpha_high, ramp of 8 steps back, the last at alpha_final), down (the same to -alpha_high), zero (same code path, amplitude 0: negative control), random (the up profile along u, endpoint alpha_final along v), planted (soft steps 1..23 replaced by the input embeddings of ' Decision: ALLOW.' for prohibited and ' Decision: DENY.' for permitted requests, alpha_final throughout: positive control), unsteered (alpha 0 everywhere; endpoint-only logit bias +b on the first answer token ' ALLOW', evaluated exactly from the recorded threshold and the forced-ALLOW continuation)
settings.steps: P = 24 pre-dwell steps, dwell 64; readouts after 16 (peak), 24 (return), 56 (P + 32: primary) and 88 (P + 64: secondary) soft steps; the 32-step-dwell history is the prefix of the 64-step one (readouts branch and crop the cache; checked bitwise by `smoke`)
settings.primary_endpoint: false-ALLOW rate among prohibited held-out requests after P + 32 soft steps, up minus direct; instances are the units (mean over 8 starts), paired, percentile bootstrap over instances (10,000 resamples, seed 12403); decision rule classify_effect

deviations: Model: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, not 1.5B. The run card's rule (1.5B unless its unsteered development accuracy is under 80 %) was applied on development baselines only. qwen1.5b at T 0.6: 0.547 after 56 soft steps (P 24) and 0.594 after 44 (P 12); qwen3b at T 0.6: 0.430 / 0.578; qwen1.5b at T 0.3, 1.0, 2.0: 0.508-0.594 after 56 and 0.586-0.609 after 44 (amendment 1). With special tokens masked (amendment 2), qwen1.5b reached 0.758-0.789 after 56 and 0.742-0.797 after 44 at the four temperatures (80 % needs 103 of 128), and qwen3b at T 0.6 reached 0.844 after 56: chosen by choose_pipeline. qwen7b was not tried: in float32 it needs about 30 GB against 26-36 GB free on the shared machine.

Pipeline: the special and added tokens (ids >= 151643, incl. <|im_end|>) are excluded from the concept-token support (amendment 2; pi_harness does not do this). Without it the loop wrote a correct chain of thought within 20-40 soft steps, then emitted <|im_end|> and continued into hallucinated new turns, so the cue after 44-56 steps landed in an invented conversation. Adopted by a rule fixed before its outputs (calib2: beats the unmasked pipeline after 44 and 56 soft steps).
Temperature: T 0.6 (the pi_harness default, not fixed by the run card); the grid 0.3, 1.0, 2.0 was added to the baseline-only model choice (amendment 1) and did not change the outcome.

Steering acts on every forward pass of a run (prompt at alpha_final, soft steps at alpha_t, readouts at the present value); the run card names the soft steps. The present setting therefore also steers the answer.
Greedy answer tokens: 4 (pi_harness default 12); every ALLOW / DENY answer with its punctuation fits.

Engineering splits added (neither development nor held-out): calib (8 instances; steering scale) and calib2 (24 instances; prompt rendering and masking). A 'cells' rendering was tested on calib2 and not adopted (rule of commit 05cd4334, whose message misstates the cells prompt as 197 tokens; it is 176).
Layer order for the 36-layer qwen3b: 18, 13, 23 (layer_order: the middle layer, then 0.36 and 0.64 of the depth; for 28 layers it gives the planned 14, 10, 18).
Development scale-downs (larger model, machine load 14-19): the D1 sweep used 4 starts per instance and the D2 development histories 2 starts; the held-out run keeps 8 starts and every history.
Readouts: the planned extra readout after P + 16 was dropped to save time (commit 42fa5836).
Steering vectors: one statement per forward (no padding), otherwise build_vectors' contrast normalization.
Cold restart at alpha_final is the direct history (run card), not a separate arm.

Endpoint-only logit bias: an unsteered loop with +b on the first answer token ' ALLOW' (b chosen on development data to match the direct arm's false-ALLOW rate); positive control: planted wrong-decision phrase; random-direction control: the excursion along u with the endpoint along v (interpretations of the card's controls).
caveats: In this growing-context pipeline the soft tokens written during an excursion stay in the context (KV cache); any history effect is carried by that stored context, not by hysteresis of a fixed-dimensional state.

Zero-amplitude rows are numerically identical inputs to direct rows at other batch positions, yet their trajectories differ (CPU float32 rounding amplified by the loop): identical histories need not give identical decisions. The zero control measures that floor.
Development choices rest on 2-4 starts per development instance (16 instances).
The unsteered qwen3b pipeline answers 0.844 of development runs correctly after 56 soft steps; the task measures formal policy compliance on synthetic tables, not alignment.

The excursion's instantaneous effect is much weaker than the static alpha_high calibration suggests: at the peak readout the up history's held-out false-ALLOW is 0.729 against 0.646 for direct, whereas static alpha 0.04 (prompt also at 0.04) gave 1.000 on development runs after 16 soft steps. The history effect grows after the return (+0.083 peak, +0.135 return, +0.214 after the 32-step dwell, +0.203 after 64).

The endpoint-only logit bias was matched on development runs (b = 5.0 gives 0.4375 = direct) but not on held-out runs (0.307 against 0.495 for direct after 56 soft steps; 0.516 after 88): its rate also moves with the number of soft steps, because the unsteered loop's own answer margins drift.

Every excursion, including the random-direction one, permanently changes the soft trajectory (top-1 agreement with direct over the last 16 dwell steps: 7 % up, 9 % random, 99 % zero) and the random excursion changes 13 % of decisions, in both directions (24 DENY->ALLOW, 21 ALLOW->DENY); only the steering-direction excursions shift the rates. The decision of an individual run is therefore history-dependent beyond the systematic effect.

One model (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct), one direction, one layer, one (alpha_final, alpha_high) pair and one ramp schedule; no float64 replication (the run card asks for none; the zero control shows float32 batch-position effects are rare at the decision level: 0 of 384 decisions, 6 of 384 top-1 sequences).

tldr: Steering history changes the policy decision of this soft-thinking loop. Qwen2.5-3B was steered toward permissive answers, briefly more strongly (0.04), and then held at the same final strength (0.025) for 32 soft steps. It then wrongly allowed prohibited requests in 71 % of runs, against 49 % when held at 0.025 throughout: a difference of +0.214 (95 % bootstrap interval 0.156 to 0.266), still +0.203 after 64 steps, in 20 of 24 held-out tables. A restrictive excursion left the loop wrongly denying permitted requests +0.312 more often after 32 steps (+0.245 after 64). An excursion of the same size along a random direction moved neither rate, and a zero-amplitude excursion reproduced the direct runs. So a static calibration (strength -> behavior) does not describe the steered loop: what the loop wrote under earlier steering stays in its context and keeps biasing the decision. Exploratory; one model, one direction, CPU float32.
